title: Completed ordinary direct image commutes with constant scalar restriction
statement: For a prime l and a scheme morphism f:X→S, the actual completed direct image and constant scalar restriction [def-sfb-diagonal-trace-models, def-sfb-diagonal-limit-interface] have a natural isomorphism diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S ≅ diagonalCompletedRestriction l X ⋙ lowerStar (ModuleCat (ULift Z_l)) f. The map on every section is heterogeneously the identity. No localization, varying coefficient system, Chern datum or coefficient cone is assumed.

source.place: paragraph (1), ordinary scalar restrictions before right derivation

proof.text: Compose the completed inverse-image coefficient map with each finite projection. Its limit-lift equation, the two completion-map projection equations and naturality of the constant inverse-image comparison give compatibility with the constant Z_l structure map. The limit projections jointly detect equality.

Take the adjunction transpose. The constant direct-image comparison sends a sheafified constant section to the same constant on the pulled-back chart. The constantCommuteCompose inverse has this same normalization by sheafComposeIso_hom_fac. Hence both fixed Z_l scalar actions agree on each module section.

Define both components of the isomorphism by identity functions, linear by the scalar equality. Chart naturality, inverse identities and naturality in the module hold by extensionality and reflexivity. The section normalization is HEq.rfl.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalTraceCompletedScalarSquare (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) :
    ∃ e : diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S ≅
        diagonalCompletedRestriction l X ⋙
          lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ_[l])) f,
      ∀ (M : DiagonalCompleted l X) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((diagonalTracePush l f ⋙ diagonalCompletedRestriction l S).obj M).obj.obj U),
        HEq ((e.hom.app M).hom.app U x) x
